career_ladder.note: Career progression outlined for Deputy Collector (Tamil Nadu Civil Service), the premier executive cadre recruited via Group-I. Officers are inducted into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under the state civil service quota as per DoPT / UPSC promotion regulations, typically after 12–16 years of meritorious state service.

exam_scheme.note: Combined Civil Services Examination-I comprises a Preliminary screening test, followed by a Written Main Examination (consisting of 1 qualifying Tamil paper and 3 descriptive General Studies papers) and an Interview/Oral Test. Paper I of Mains is compulsory qualifying; marks in Papers II, III, IV and the Interview determine final merit ranking.

stages.source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 04/2024, Section 6.1: Scheme of Preliminary Examination

papers.paper_name: General Studies (Degree Standard, 175 Qs) & Aptitude and Mental Ability (SSLC Standard, 25 Qs)

stages.source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 04/2024, Section 6.2: Scheme of Main Examination

papers.paper_name: Paper I — Tamil Eligibility Test (SSLC Standard)
Paper II — General Studies (Degree Standard: Modern History & Indian Culture, Social Issues in India & TN, General Aptitude)
Paper III — General Studies (Degree Standard: Indian Polity, Science & Technology, Tamil Society & Heritage)
Paper IV — General Studies (Degree Standard: Geography of India & TN, Environment & Biodiversity, Indian Economy)

stages.source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 04/2024, Section 6.2: Oral Test / Interview (100 Marks)

financial_package.note: Salaries for Tamil Nadu Group-I officers are governed by the Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Rules 2017 (Level 22 of the State Pay Matrix: ₹56,100 - ₹2,05,700). State government DA and HRA slabs apply as notified by Finance (Pay Cell) Department, Government of Tamil Nadu.
financial_package.pay_source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 04/2024, Section 3: Posts and Vacancies (Level 22, Rs. 56,100 - 2,05,700 under TN Revised Pay Rules 2017)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate assumes Level 22 entry basic pay ₹56,100 with 58% DA plus Tamil Nadu Grade I-A/Grade I HRA (approx. ₹5,000 - ₹8,000) and City Compensatory Allowance. Net pay accounts for Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS/NPS 10% of Basic+DA), NHIS, and state professional tax.
official_perks: Official government vehicle with driver for duty (Deputy Collector / DSP)
Designated government residential bungalow / camp office accommodation
Medical insurance coverage under New Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) for state employees and dependents
Field inspection allowances and Camp / Travelling Allowance
Subsidized electricity and official telephone / internet connectivity allowance
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and surrender leave encashment benefits
